entries.topic: Owner orders guarded implementation of official identity and safe single Production migration
facts: Owner says to proceed with safe conversion, automate as much as possible and request manual action only for actual lack of capability/rights.

Source PR #626 changes official Android and Web public naming only; existing Android package/signature/current API domain, backend Worker, DO SQLite and Firebase identity are deliberately preserved for old-client compatibility.
Current vc112 requires beta-vcN tag and exact beta versionName. Changing signed APK version identity or prematurely moving its trusted API host is forbidden until compatibility proof.

New GitHub read-only Cloudflare preflight workflow uses existing scoped Beta environment credentials to determine if inventory.supra.cc.cd is unassigned or still owned by old Stable Worker. It makes no provider changes.
Official new hostname and old legacy hostname must ultimately be attached to same Worker and Durable Object identity, not separate Stable Worker. No domain/DO migration has been done yet.
User-facing web channel labels and version presentation lose Beta; technical release tags, GitHub secret names and provider IDs may retain beta internally to preserve existing upgrades.

Owner wants actual rollout, but staged release must stop on Cloudflare hostname conflict, unresolved OAuth callback, backup/readback or failing GitHub protected release gates. No manual Cloudflare steps requested before tool evidence.
PR #626 Draft release boundary: only source candidate and read-only preflight; no runtime merge/release/pass claimed.
